Permits & License Committee  September 12, 2024
Minutes  Page 1 of 3

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  September 12, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on September 12, 2024 at 2:03 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on August 22, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Darby Dixon Toy Giveaway Event
  at 3215 Bardton Ave., Public Property, on Saturday, December 07, 2024 from 9:00 am –
  12:00 pm. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Applicant approved for a one (1) day event within grass field on corner
  of Woodworth Ave and Bartdon Ave.IPD will staff two (2) Police officers and two (2) TCO’s
  will be deployed for public safety and traffic control; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  Health Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385148)

Item #2:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Snowy Winter Wonderland Event at
  2900 W. Imperial Hwy., Private Property., Private Property, on Sunday, December 08, 2024
  from 12:00 pm – 3:00 pm. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant approved for a one (1) day event within
  Crenshaw Imperial Plaza parking lot; Applicant must have water –filled barriers for public

  unanimously (Activity No. 00385149).

Item #3:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of City of Inglewood to host an IUSD Event at 2640 B West Imperial
  HWY., Private Property, on Friday, December 13, 2024, from 3:00 pm – 6:00 pm.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Applicant approved for a one (1) day event; Water-filled barriers will be required if the event
  is moved to the parking lot; IPD will staff two(2) police officers for public safety; A watch
  Commander will be notified / and extra patrol will be provided; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State Health Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385150).
New Business License Request (s):

Item #4:  Celso Hernandez DBA Celso’s Flower to operate as a Sidewalk Vendor at 720 E Florence
  Ave; Denial based on Code Enforcement recommendation; Applicant is within the no
  vending zone; motion carried unanimously to deny the applicant for sidewalk vending
  (Activity No. 00385182)

Item #5:  Hao Shen DBA Unice Hair Salon to operate as a Hair/ Nail Salon Lot at 3111 W. Century
  Blvd. # 100  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City;
  Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies
  of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type
  is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including
  cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises;Massage therapy of any part of the body
  is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or
  any Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance;Adhere to all State, Federal and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business

  Applicant is within the no vending zone; motion carried unanimously to deny the applicant
  for sidewalk vending Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384587)
